title: eludite/test/attached
description: The shell's answer to an `attach` update of a debug run (VSTest): whether its debug adapter attached to the testhost. The host answers vstest.console's `TestExecution.EditorAttachDebugger2` with `TestExecution.EditorAttachDebuggerCallback` (`Attached`, `ErrorMessage`), and the testhost runs the tests (under the debugger when attached). A debug run whose attach is not answered within 60 s is answered as not attached.

runId.description: The discovery's or run's id, unique within one host process, from 1 (discoveries and runs share one counter).

message.description: Why the adapter did not attach.

accepted.description: False when the run is over or was not waiting for that process.
